workload: Existing mutable synthetic fixture under uncontrolled human traffic; no HTTP/browser actions made by collector. Cache/source/session state not interrogated or reset.
sampling: Six cgroup-v2 snapshots at approximately two-second spacing; host monotonic time for CPU denominator. Cgroup includes page cache, regular healthcheck and transient docker-exec cat observer. PID1 VmRSS is separately read from proc; kernel kB interpreted as KiB. Samples are non-atomic across files.
comparison: Exploratory snapshot only, not a fair benchmark or whole-Homarr RAM-savings comparison.
